theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intros Hup Hinit
  have Hlen1 := InitStatesLength Hinit
  have Hnd := InitStatesNodup Hinit
  have Hndef := UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined Hinit) Hup
  refine ⟨updatedStates σ ks' vs', rfl, updatedStatesInit Hlen1 Hndef Hnd, ?_⟩
  clear Hndef
  induction Hup generalizing σ''
  case update_none =>
    rw [InitStatesUpdated Hinit]
    constructor
  case update_some σ x v σ₀ xs vs σ₁ Hup Hups ih =>
    have Heq₀ := UpdateStateUpdated Hup
    have Hnotdef := UpdateStateNotDefMonotone' (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined Hinit) Hups) Hup
    cases Hup with
    | update Hold =>
    apply UpdateStates.update_some (σ':=updatedStates σ₀ ks' vs')
    . simp [Heq₀, updatedStates]
      rw [← updatedStateComm']
      . apply updatedStateUpdate (v':=_)
        apply InitStatesSomeMonotone Hold
        exact updatedStatesInit Hlen1 Hnotdef Hnd
      . rw [List.unzip_zip Hlen1]
        exact fun Hin => nomatch Hold.symm.trans (Hnotdef x Hin)
    . exact ih Hinit
